answer: Beacon sampling with a compute heartbeat stops hollow identities. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents at random; each must solve a small proof-of-work challenge in 10 min, proving real compute. Sybil identities spread like yarrow runners, many shoots, one root, but one root cannot power dozens of heartbeats at once. Faking N identities costs N x $0.40 of rented compute per check; an honest agent pays $0.40 once and keeps full earnings.
